summary: Validate standard effect metadata against managed control paths

delivery.outcome: Proposed standard changes defer when effect metadata is absent or omits CI/hooks/review-authority effects evident from managed paths; accurately declared effects keep approval requirements and existing adoption is preserved. Tested independent protected merge.
nonGoals: No new standard adoption, CI/hooks/authority change, dependency or package release
Preserve foreign ticket042 and every retained worktree

architecture.decision: Validate explicit effect declarations before proposing changes; controlled managed-path coverage is a conservative lower bound, never evidence that other runtime effects are absent.
architecture.rollback: Protected revert of additive scope correction.

validation.evidence: Full test and governance gates; independent exact-head review and merge.
